items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; expected to return vs Eagles.
items.why: No designation on final report; Schefter notes expected to play.
items.implication: WR1/2 return boosts Rams passing; monitor for snap limits.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets likely high if unlimited; pairs with Adams.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN after hamstring; full participant Friday, no designation.
items.why: Practiced fully; Rapoport confirms good to go.
items.implication: Elite WR1 return in smash DvP vs Cowboys.
items.opportunity: High target share expected; Texans high implied points.

items.text: Justin Jefferson listed OUT (ankle) for Week 4 vs Dolphins.
items.implication: Major Vikings WR void; Addison primary beneficiary.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed OUT (hamstring) vs Rams; Goedert also OUT.
items.why: Officially ruled out; Schefter confirms Smith.
items.implication: Eagles offense depleted (also Baun); Hurts/ remaining WRs impacted.
items.opportunity: Increased looks for other Eagles pass-catchers.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot) LP-DNP-LP trend; already dealt with cracked rib this season.
items.opportunity: If out, Chargers WR hierarchy shifts.

items.text: Nacua return great but possible snap limits; Collins excellent spot as Cowboys inflate WR scoring 7.3% most in NFL, Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.why: DvP data + implied totals; hip/hamstring returns.
items.implication: Start both confidently as WR1s if active/unlimited.

items.text: Jordan Addison opportunity peaks home vs borderline secondary with Jefferson out; moment truthers waited for.
Breece Hall listed OUT; AD Mitchell also OUT for Jets.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup elevated; Wilson target share up.
Miami RB void for ROS; handcuffs elevated long-term.

items.text: Jadarian Price listed OUT (chest); Charbonnet also out.
items.implication: Seahawks RB role further eroded short-term.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.
LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches (RB5 util), double-digit target share every game; NYG allows 5.1 YPC.
Jadarian Price tough start: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet back practicing; still passes eye test long-term.
items.implication: Avoid short-term; hold for ROS upside.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton: low 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snaps to 42%, 13% third-down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
